title: NIST WebBook: Mercury is Hg, molecular weight 200.59 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Mercury as Hg, molecular weight 200.59 amu, CAS 7439-97-6.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Mercury, CAS Registry Number 7439-97-6, lists molecular formula Hg and molecular weight 200.59 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 201.9706430 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Hg. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
